Problem Statement:
Selection sort
 is an algorithm that selects the smallest element from an unsorted list in each iteration and places that element at the beginning of the unsorted list.You have to sort the given array of integer value in selection sort manner. 
Input Description:
Given an integer 'n' which indicates the length of array and next line followed by space separated ‘n’ integer values.Where 1 
Output Description:
Print step by step process of applying selection sort(print all the iteration of selection sorting).where 1 
Explanation:
Selects the smallest element from an unsorted list in each iteration and places that element at the beginning of the unsorted list,First 2,then followed by 10,20,120,1050. 
Sample Input:
5
20 120 10 1050 2 
Sample Output:
2 120 10 1050 20
2 10 120 1050 20
2 10 20 1050 120
2 10 20 120 1050
2 10 20 120 1050
